assets.title: Bram's Stall, Brindle Crossroads
assets.description: A roadside market stall at dusk where the north road meets the river. Across the top, a red-and-cream striped canvas awning with a scalloped edge (rows 28-44), held by two rough wooden posts at the far left and right edges; two warm lanterns hang from it. Beyond the counter, the Brindle countryside at dusk: a violet sky with warm peach clouds, rolling green fields and hedgerows, a watermill with its wheel by a winding river on the left, a distant hill on the right crowned by the silhouette of the castle of Crownhold, a wooden signpost with two blank arrow boards, a couple of barrels and a crate by the right post. A plain wooden plank shelf hangs from the awning on two ropes, its top at row 98 (x 140-410). The counter top is a worn wooden board; below it, the counter's front is a canvas skirt over trestle legs, with grass at the very bottom.

Clean, hand-placed pixel art on a strict square grid: every art pixel is one solid, perfectly square block of a single flat colour. No anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no texture noise, no dithering, no painterly brushwork. A limited palette of warm, hue-shifted colours: shadows lean violet-blue, highlights lean warm yellow. One warm key light from the upper left, cool violet ambient shadow on the right and underneath. Strong readable silhouette. No text, letters, numbers, runes that look like writing, signatures or watermarks.

A 96x42 pixel art overlay for a treasure chest: only the hasp of a rusty iron padlock: pitted grey iron with orange-brown rust, on a fully transparent canvas the size of the chest part it sits on, drawn so each art pixel is a crisp square block 10 px wide. Front view, symmetrical. 1-pixel very dark plum outline. Nothing else in the image.

Subject: The hasp of a rusty iron padlock: pitted grey iron with orange-brown rust, hanging from the middle of the lid's bottom edge, inside the lid's lock seat (x 40-55, rows 34-41). Everything else transparent.

It must show: only inside x 40-55, rows 34-41; symmetrical.

Lean on these palette ramps (dark to light): steel 1-3 (#383d48 #626d80 #93a2b6); umber 2-4 (#4b2212 #6e3d22 #8e5b37).

Avoid: any part of the chest itself; a glow; text or letters.
